caption: The drawing depicts the head of a classical-style statue or sculpture, rendered in shades of brown, gray, and olive green. The face is smooth and symmetrical, with defined lips, nose, and closed eyes, and stylized hair curling around the ears and forehead. The head wears an elaborate helmet decorated with two large, detailed leaves, one on each side, both colored in shades of green and brown with visible veins. At the very top of the helmet, there is a vertical, rectangular crest, shaded in brown tones with a wood-like texture. The lower part of the head and chin area appears to be broken or fragmentary, with rough, jagged edges in darker brown. The overall background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Head from a Statue: Minerva
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
